newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 12.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Presidential office to set up constitutional revision consultant committee
-- Floods in Hsinchu, Taichung kill four
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Three killed, one missing in northern and central Taiwan floods
-- Kaohsiung's 5th, 10th Credit Cooperatives taken over by cooperative union and central deposit insurance company
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui asks for continued negotiation with opposition parties on constitutional amendments
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Economics ministry to remove requirement that export-import companies must have capital funds of no less than T$5 million
-- Chinese President Jiang Zemin to take part in Hong Kong handover ceremony
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Net outflow of foreign fund posts new high in May at US$436 million
-- 48 financial institutions found not participating in savings deposit insurance programme
